purpose: Exploratory pilot of two proposed neuron-reset controllers

signals.activity: fraction of the current training minibatch with positive ReLU output
signals.gradient: 75th percentile absolute incoming-weight gradient per neuron
signals.loss_saliency: 75th percentile of absolute activation times activation-gradient, conditional on firing

normalization: per-layer robust references are medians of positive 75th-percentile scales observed in the first 1000 training steps, then frozen

decision.P-FLD: FLD rule or causal Theil-Sen forecast<=0.2 for 2 observations while current degree<=0.5 and slope<-0.02 per monitoring interval

reset: reinitialize incoming weights and bias from the original initialization, zero outgoing weights and reset optimizer slices
primary_comparisons: each proposed method versus every baseline on paired fresh seeds
uncertainty: historical task-stratified bootstrap 95% CI for continuity
Bonferroni sensitivity interval across 10 candidate-baseline comparisons
pilot_success_rule: candidate exceeds the best published baseline by at least 0.2 percentage points, with the Bonferroni seed-block interval above zero, and no collapse or missing prospective logs
claim_limit: This single-setting pilot cannot establish SOTA. A positive result must be replicated on an additional valid continual-learning setting and more seeds before that claim.
